title: Degreewise affine Hom complex comparison
statement: With the notation and hypotheses of lem-sc-affine-hom-complex-evaluation-d, for every complex I there is a chain isomorphism d as there, and in every degree n the component of d followed by precomposition and evaluation equals the component of the mapped adjunction counit.

source.place: Tags 0BUZ, 0BV0, and 0AX3, termwise affine Hom evaluation

proof.text: Construct the affine Hom comparison degree by degree using the product projection to source degree zero, identify the restricted direct-image unit with the pushforward structure sheaf, and apply the sectionwise counit evaluation.
